To:   
Medi-Cal IPAs 
From:  
IEHP – Utilization Management  
   
 
 
Date:  
April 22, 2025 
           
Subject: 
UPDATE: Medi-Cal Denial Log Review Tool 
 
Inland Empire Health Plan (IEHP) recently updated the Medi-Cal Denial Log Review Tool Template with the 
following changes. 
 
Medi-Cal Denial Log Review Template: 
• The denial log review tool added the auditing element “Access to Care”.  
• Please note this is NOT a new auditing element. The “Access to Care” element was carved out and no 
longer captured under “Provider/Member Outreach”.  
 
IEHP will begin auditing element “Access to Care” starting with the IPAs April 2025 Data.  
 
This template is now available on the IEHP Provider website: 
www.providerservices.iehp.org > Resources > Resources for Providers > Forms > DOA > Denial Log 
Review Tool – Medi-Cal or click here. 
 
For questions, please contact Juan Ortega at Ortega-J2@iehp.org or Jessica Gonzalez at gonzalez-j6@iehp.org. 
All IEHP communications can be found at www.providerservices.iehp.org > News & Updates > Notices
